methodology: OS-level verification: the real server (uvicorn) served HTTP on 127.0.0.1 while a watcher polled Get-NetTCPConnection for ALL processes every 400 ms for 30 s, covering /health, /v1/models, /v1/route and a real /v1/chat/completions LLM inference. Every sampled row with a non-loopback RemoteAddress is recorded with its owning PID. Rows owned by the server process tree (venv launcher + spawned interpreter, see process_tree) are the PROOF TARGET and must be zero; rows owned by other processes document ambient machine noise (browsers, OneDrive etc.). Firewall profiles from netsh. Limitation: TCP only (UDP/ICMP are not listed by Get-NetTCPConnection); llama.cpp/uvicorn make no UDP calls, and offline_check.json already confirmed 0 externally-addressed sockets at the Python API level.
